content.description: Masked On Buttons (MOB) is series of NFT collections minted exclusively on the Cardano Blockchain. The collections feature button-eyed, strangely colored characters wearing face masks. Each MOB artwork is digitally hand-drawn up to the smallest details, unique, and comes with a variety of attributes and rarities. Every MOB collection forms part of a community-driven MOB lore narrative; making every MOB holder not only own an image stored in the blockchain but also own a piece of the story. The goal of the creators is for the CNFT community to find deeper value in every MOB art, both at the community and personal level.
